name: What should I do to prepare my home for a door frame installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for a door frame installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for door frame installation, clear the area around the doorway of furniture, decor, and anything that could obstruct the work or get damaged. Remove any existing window treatments if they are very close to the door. You might also want to lay down drop cloths or plastic sheeting to protect flooring from dust and debris. If it's an exterior door, ensure easy access for our team. Our crew will take additional precautions, but these steps help ensure a smooth and efficient installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around the doorway, remove obstructions, and protect your flooring from dust and debris to prepare for door frame installation.
